headline: Pakistan Weekly SPI Inflation Dips 0.11% on Lower Food and Energy Prices
summary: Pakistan's Sensitive Price Index-based inflation decreased by 0.11 percent during the week ended November 26, driven by lower prices for tomatoes, onions, and liquefied petroleum gas.
why: High-frequency inflation indicators provide immediate insight into consumer cost pressures and near-term monetary policy trajectories in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: A drop in weekly price indices indicates easing short-term inflationary pressure on consumers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
